BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy-fourth Year of the Republic of India as
follows:—
1. (1) This Act may be called the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023.
(2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in
the Official Gazette, appoint; and different dates may be appointed for amendments relating
to different enactments mentioned in the Schedule.
2. The enactments mentioned in column (4) of the Schedule are hereby amended to the
extent and in the manner mentioned in column (5) thereof.
3. The fines and penalties provided under various provisions in the enactments
mentioned in the Schedule shall be increased by ten per cent. of the minimum amount of fine
or penalty, as the case may be, prescribed therefor, after the expiry of every three years from
the date of commencement of this Act.
